text: OpenSSH signal handling race. A signal handling race in sshd can permit remote unauthenticated attacks on affected versions. Defensive guidance: Check the release-specific Ubuntu advisory; install the fixed openssh package for that release and verify the running service has been restarted. Before changing a system, record its distribution release and installed package version. Match that release against the linked vendor advisory rather than assuming all Linux systems have the same exposure. Plan the update in a maintenance window and retain the package manager output for review. After updating, verify the installed version and any affected running services. Record the verification date and the advisory reference. Classroom lifecycle labels describe a fictional training environment; they do not establish that a real host was compromised or that exploitation is currently occurring.
